description: P25 (plan M6-M9 §2.7, §5.1): The Stonehold Highlands of level.world; its bounds tile the interior with the other four regions.
journal_note: The giants' highlands: Ulfra's Skarn Steading, threatened by a hired siege line; the Standing Stones that grow a giant to stage 6; the Giant's Stair up from the Mere and the long Ironway round by Aldmere; the Cairnlands; and Harrok the Unbowed in the Moot beside the Stone Throne.
